title.value: Joint Multisided Exposure Fairness for Recommendation
title.justification: The paper focuses on the concept of joint multisided exposure fairness in recommendation systems.
title.quote: Haolun Wu, Bhaskar Mitra, Chen Ma, Fernando Diaz, and Xue Liu. 2022. Joint Multisided Exposure Fairness for Recommendation.

extractions.description: This paper addresses the issue of exposure fairness in recommender systems, particularly focusing on systemic disparities that affect groups of users and items. The authors extend existing frameworks to introduce a family of metrics that quantify joint multisided exposure (JME) fairness from the perspective of both consumers and producers. It investigates fairness concerns beyond individual users and items, identifying systemic biases, and proposes stochastic ranking policies optimized towards these fairness goals.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily focuses on fairness in recommendation systems rather than environmental or ecological sustainability.
